notes.title: Devlog 2025-03-21 (Episode 4 - Part 2 is out NOW!)
notes.content:
Happy Friday, everyone!

It's a great one because today is launch day!

We've been working very hard on this one, and we're sorry it took a bit longer than usual. But I'm happy to say we're in good shape for the next upcoming release.

Some highlights that you can look forward to in the newly released content (minor spoilers ahead):

[list]
[*] If you and Matthias have been making eyes at each other, you can share a very tight, uncomfortable ride in a small elevator. You won't be able to help but 'accidentally' rub up against Matthias and fluster him.
[*] 
[*] If you want to get a little closer to the enigmatic and usually inappropriate Andreas, you can do so while on a chaotic shopping spree for some exotic substances.
[*] 
[*] If you just want to spend some slice-of-life time with Veera and Khalil, you can meet some new friends and pay homage to some loved ones. (You are loved and missed, and now you are forever immortalised little sweetpea.)
[*] 
[*] If you have a thing for the strong Captain types, you'll have the opportunity to make some suggestive comments and take some mildly inappropriate actions.
[*] 
[*] You get to meet some new alien species. Some of them are icky and gross (and yet also sexy, according to feedback? \o/)
[*] 
[*] A new sexual orientation system that allows you to pick who you want to be able to flirt with.
[*] 
[*] A new rival system (very new and not fully fleshed out yet.)
[*] 
[*] A new status message on the main menu will show you how much of all the available content you have experienced. (It's impossible to hit 100% right now due to some seasonal content.)
[*] 
[*] All the regular 'new' stuff: new music, new backgrounds, new characters, new portraits, etc.
[/list]

We also added some niche scenes that most of you will probably never see. The conditions for these to trigger are stringent, but they hit the spot just right if/when you do see them.

Now that this release is done, we'll probably take a break for a day or two and then jump back into things. Our attention will shift to working on and releasing Project Syndicate in May while still working on Infinite Stars on the sidelines:

[list]
[*] Bugfixing and polishing existing content.
[*] 
[*] Adding some more intimate scenes for patrons.
[*] 
[*] Adding some more cutesy ,non-intimate scenes.
[*] 
[*] Expanding on the friendship and rival system.
[*] 
[*] Finalising and adding the new outfit system.
[*] 
[*] Finishing the next (halfway? done) content.
[/list]

Enough of my ramblings. You can find the latest public build on itchio or Steam, and the latest Patreon Build is available [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/124802102]>>>here<<<[/url]

Those of you who have been around for a while know that we love doing cross-promotions during releases, and this release is no different. We have something special thanks to Esh from [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/steamberrystudio/about]Steamberry Studio[/url], the creator of When Stars Collide!

When Stars Collide is a fantastic sci-fi visual novel, (inspired by Star Trek, Firefly and Star Gate) and Esh is an even fantastickler(er?) human. You should definitely check out her project and consider supporting her on Patreon if you like what you see.

Your Mah'Abeu can also roleplay to your heart's content as Ari and Esher from When Stars Collide.

Have a fantastic weekend, be kind to others and stay safe! <3

notes.title: Devlog 2024-03-15
notes.content:
Another busy  (two) week(s), and another Friday to report on it.
I'll share some of what we've been up to! (Veera's intimate scene is still... on its way. Been banging my head against a wall with some writers block on her ff scene as I don't want it to be 'just another smut scene')
We're adding another new player portrait.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223954/1fb089e6ae8020b686a1f0848d8c978f42217674.png[/img]
(All of our Captain+ patrons and subscribestars get their own custom drawn portrait, either of themselves, or of their OC)

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/100411033]We have several new audio tracks, and I took the liberty to attach one of them to this post! (The track is one of Sonia's new themes.)[/url]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223954/77cae3057fdaab57d128157a4705e8832ae545c6.png[/img]
We're adding two new Cephilusk twins for your Mah'Abeu to run into while looking for the elusive Naaka. These two are from the Khaelbesh Cephilusk tribe, and I've included a short excerpt from the upcoming content.

[h2][b]!! SPOILERS AHEAD !![/b][/h2]

[i]A large Cephilusk had bumped into me, almost knocking me to the floor, but they just kept on walking. Andreas turned to her and shouted.
"Rude!"
The Cephilusk woman stopped and turned towards Andreas, her eye needling in his direction as she rose on her hind tentacles. I suddenly felt an immense sense of dread pressing against my throat.
"Did the shrimp spit on my honour?"
"No– My apologies, he didn't mean it."
"Let the manling speak for himself Mahlabeu."
"I meant it. I spit on your honour! No one insults my faiyarga! Now apologise to them."
The Cephilusk inched closer towards Andreas– alku'ahf– She– She was going to pounce and snap his neck.
"You aren't in Sol anymore. Yumans should know their place when they aren't in Sol."
She spat in his direction and leapt into the air– but Andreas was expecting her movement and dodged out of the way, tripping and falling to the floor as he did so.
"Come closer little yuman shrimp so I can peel your skin from your face! Let me pull your innards through your mouth and dangle you over my birthing pool for my young to nibble on your entrails."
I knew that voice– I knew this woman, but how?
"Bold threats from a Kahlbeara as ugly as you."[/i]

Have a fantastic weekend everyone!

notes.title: Devlog 2024-02-09 (Episode 4 - Part 1 is out NOW!)
notes.content:
It's Friday! And this is a special Friday because it's a RELEASE Friday!
That's right! Episode 4 - Part 1 is now live!

Update Edit: [i]It's also a sad day for my family. I lost someone dear to me this morning, someone even dearer to my loved ones, and my heart is aching with them for our loss. I wish things weren't the way they are. I wish I could do more to ease their suffering.[/i]

[b]Project Details:[/b]
167,666 words in total. (That's roughly the same length as the first two Harry Potter novels combined)
825 possible choices.

Patrons can get their version over here [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/98143999](win|mac|lin)[/url] or here [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/98144000](android)[/url], and everyone else can get the full game on Steam or Itchio!

Episode 4 - Part 1 continues the story after the dramatic conclusion from Episode 3.

It introduces several new characters, several new and redrawn backgrounds, several new portraits, several new music tracks, an overhauled story controller, a new free-roam mechanic, a new star system navigation interface, a lore gallery with unlockable entries, a system for players to load custom-made stories written by other players into the game, a seasonal event (Spooktober Heist), and nearly 40K additional words of content (some being intimate content for Kiaria, Lochem and Khalil).

It also includes two very special player portraits! Thanks to the amazing ladies from Wanderlust Games, you can now play your Mah'Abeu as a younger version of Damon or Ayame from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1642870/Andromeda_Six/]Andromeda Six![/url] (Seriously, if you're hearing about Andromeda Six for the first time– You're about to fall in love. Go check them out and support them if your wallet allows!)
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223954/fcda2dabb554ced96b050a466d07e937c7791d91.png[/img]

We've been working extremely hard to bring this release to you, and while we've added a ton of new things, we would have loved to add more. Sadly, we had to draw a line in the sand and release what was available.

[b]Some of the things that we could add before the deadline that were requested by our beta testers:[/b]
[list]
[*] MC is more knowledgeable about the Cephilusk.
[*] Added a location hint during free-roam sequences.
[*] Made Kiaria more Kiaria when dealing with current events.
[*] Your Mah'Abue now crafts the notice being sent to the crew.
[*] Several more personality options (with more on their way)
[*] Most free-roam scenes now have the crew members touching on or hinting at the current situation.
[*] Fixed some logic bugs with Sonia's scene.
[*] Adjusted Andreas' scene with an additional choice if he becomes too much.
[*] Added some additional logic and checks to the response you can give when the crew/your LI asks about how you are coping. (Might still expand on this.)
[*] Your Mah'Abue now has more control over how they handle Nikau.
[*] Added Lindi's music track.
[*] An additional scene for Khalil
[/list]

[b]Some of the things that we couldn't add before the deadline that will be added very soon. (over the next week or three):[/b]
[list]
[*] Implementing some more of the Beta Tester feedback requests.
[*] The start of Tabitha's character arc.
[*] A free-roam scene for Lebeny, along with an additional scene.
[*] Adding a  scene with Matthias.
[*] Adding additional character expressions to some of the free-roam content.
[*] Additional music tracks where there is only silence.
[*] Missing Lore Descriptions, replacing the WiP notice with actual content.
[*] The new trailer for Episode 4.
[/list]

[b]Some of the things that we couldn't add before the deadline that will be added down the line. (more than a month from now)[/b]
[list]
[*] Additional backgrounds and characters.
[*] Continuing Episode 4, including the much-anticipated Matthias Elevator scene.
[*] Additional Lore items to unlock.
[*] More free-roam content, more character content (Reyna and more).
[*] Character relationship arcs for Raymond, Matthias, Veera and Tabitha as a prioity.
[*] Character relationship arcs for Cephilusk, Andreas and TBD a little further down the road.
[/list]

As always, despite the hours and hours and heaps of financial resources poured into the project, Infinite Stars is still entirely free! [url=https://www.patreon.com/infinitestars]If you like what we are doing and can afford to show your support, please consider joining one of our paid Patreon tiers![/url]

Infinite Stars wouldn't be nearly as cool as it is without the support of our amazing Patrons who believe in us!

If you can't afford to support us, that's cool. We still love you, and having you enjoy our game fills our hearts with joy! If you like the game, share it with your friends or give us a positive review to help with the visibility algorithms.

Have a peaceful weekend, enjoy the release, and go hug one of your loved ones!

notes.title: Devlog 2022-10-12
notes.content:
Another midweek update!

First, to all the NEW-new-new Patrons, welcome! We're on 99 monthly supporters. WOOHOO! One more to go! With this release, we have reached my personal goal of nearly doubling our monthly income. Once we hit $600 pm, I'll go celebrate with all of you in spirit. (It's not a huge amount, but got to have goals, right?) Oh, and M. Jeremiah, I saw your message, but I couldn't respond before Patreon suspended you. I don't know why they did what they did, but I'm sorry. Not sure if you will ever read this, but I saw you. <3

Now on to the fun stuff! If you aren't on the Discord server, you should be suffering from serious FOMO. Ask anyone that has been joining our work-along-chat channel. I'm not kidding or over-hyping. Let me show you some of the options we've added with all your help!

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/73203463][images][/url]

I've hinted in the past at some pretty big changes we'll be revealing on Patreon, so keep an eye out for a particular poll to appear. You'll know it when you see it! (Did you know you can follow a creator on Patreon without subscribing? Neat, huh?)

So, enough call to actions. Some changes that we've completed in the last week:
[list]
[*] Added MC eye customization options. (Options created by Discordians)
[*] Added MC hair customization options. (Options created by Discordians)
[*] Added MC body customization options. (Options created by Discordians)
[*] Halved the speed at which the cinematic intro text was displaying.
[*] Added several more reaction/personality options.
[*] Removed the flirting bug where Khalil and all the others just wouldn't take a hint.
[*] Added some more minor animations like bobbing while walking. (more to follow)
[*] Added two more MC backstories. (Options created by Discordians)
[/list]

I'm off to continue working on Infinite Stars. [url=https://discord.gg/QtAxhP6]I'll see you on Discord![/url] <3

notes.title: Dev Update 2022-01-29
notes.content:
It's Friday (OK, it's Saturday. I tried my best to get this post out yesterday, but life happened. Pretend with me. Happy Friday.)

I was hoping to release the content batch for Patron's yesterday. Unfortunately, my day job had different plans. I did manage to get around 7 hours of coding done yesterday (Today. If were are still pretending it's Friday.)

Regardless, patrons should have access to it by Monday at the latest. The public release will have to wait a bit until we've finished 2 more scenes, as the patron version will still be breaking your save games. It's intended to be played as a sneak peek.

I'm pretty excited about Kiaria's upcoming scene. I feel it has some decent writing and character development, delving a bit more into Kiaria's psyche and hinting at Khalil's past.

Project Herald also saw great progress with another character and background handed off as done.

On the coding side:
[list]
[*] Kiaria's artwork has been cleaned up, and we've split her facial expressions in the same we did with Project Herald. This allows much more expressiveness. The artwork is done, but it hasn't been implemented in-game yet as it will require a rework on how the game sprites are. Story scripting is taking a priority for now.
[*] I've added another 800+ lines of script with some interesting branching choices.
[*] Fixed an issue where relationship caps weren't working as intended.
[*] Increased max stats to 10 from 5 to pave the road for the new character stat screen we're working on.
[*] I added some new sound effects.
[*] Added a new approach to handling the "not interested" option in-game. It still has some work, but once done, you won't be seeing any romantic options for the said character if you aren't interested in them.
[/list]
Have a fantastic Saturday (Friday), and thanks for all the kind words and DM's all of you have been sending!

notes.title: Dev Update 2021-12-10
notes.content:
Time is flying by! Another week. That means there are only ten days left to get your fan art and fan fiction stories submitted for the [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/59323873]$100 Festive Fun giveaway[/url]!

Agile has been a tremendous boon to the development team, and we've only started scratching the surface.

As is tradition, I like to share some personal tidbits about my week during these Dev Updates. This week was mostly a workweek, with very few personal things happening, but I did find an African Death Moth caterpillar in my garden and shared some pictures of the majestic little bug on our [url=https://discord.gg/QtAxhP6]Discord server[/url]. Who knew worms could look so pretty!?

On the dev side, we finished the first scene of the "next day," which introduces some more tension to the story. The following three scenes are also in various states of completion, so the wait shouldn't be too long. We're pushing the current release to patrons only, but it should become public in a week or two. A quick estimation while looking at the remaining script is that we're about 2/3 done with the 3rd episode. While I enjoy working on the current episode, I want to get it done so we can start implementing some features I'm excited about.

I hope everyone is having a fantastic December so far! Stay safe, stay healthy and get some rest!

[*] Fixed a graphic issue on the main menu that wasn't detectable on my old laptop.
[*] Added a BUNCH of new patrons to the credits. <3
[/list]
